class.name: NetwSimulationHandle
class.brief_description: Where and how one [NetwEntity]'s body runs on each peer.

method.name: forget
method.description: Withdraws the selection [method simulate] made for [param entity]. The automatic policy may still select it.

method.name: simulate
method.description: Selects [param entity], so it runs here as [constant MODE_ACTIVE] while this entity runs here as [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] or [constant MODE_PREDICT]. An entity in another scene is refused with an error.

method.name: simulate_all
method.description: Selects every entity this peer holds in [param layer]. An empty [param layer] uses the [NetwInterestLayer] layers this entity is in.

method.name: simulate_nearest
method.description: Selects the [param count] entities nearest this one among those this peer holds in [param layer]. An empty [param layer] uses the [NetwInterestLayer] layers this entity is in.

method.name: simulate_none
method.description: Drops the automatic policy. Entities named with [method simulate] stay selected.

method.name: simulate_within
method.description: Selects the entities within [param meters] of this one among those this peer holds in [param layer]. A selected entity is dropped once it is 10% past [param meters].

members.member: The physics bodies this entity runs, as paths from the entity root. They are frozen on a [constant MODE_PROXY] copy. Empty means the root, when it is a [RigidBody2D] or [RigidBody3D]. Set it in [code]_init[/code]. A later write warns and is ignored.

When a body of this entity runs here as [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] and touches a free entity that also sets it, this peer claims that entity with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE]. A claimed entity claims what it touches in the same tick. It turns on [member RigidBody3D.contact_monitor] for the bodies. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
The most ticks [constant RESTORE_EXTRAPOLATED] carries a sample forward.
The mode this entity runs in on this peer. [signal mode_changed] reports each change.

The seconds the bodies must sleep before this peer releases the entity with [method NetwEntity.release_authority], or [code]0[/code] to never release. It only releases an entity this peer holds with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE]. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
How the copies this peer has no authority over run. It can change at any time.

How a sample from the authority lands on a [constant MODE_ACTIVE] copy. Under [constant NetwMultiplayer.LIVE_MODE_CHASE] the body snaps to it and the drawn position glides, up to [member NetwPredictionHandle.teleport_threshold].
When [member step] runs and when the physics server moves the bodies.
The entities this entity selects on this peer right now.

Called each tick as [code](delta: float, tick: int, is_fresh: bool)[/code] while [member mode] runs the body. Defaults to the root's [code]_network_tick[/code]. [code]is_fresh[/code] is [code]false[/code] in a replay and on a [constant MODE_ACTIVE] copy, so read input only when it is [code]true[/code].

signal.name: mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member mode] changes on this peer, after the body has switched to [param mode].

constants.constant: Not simulated. The entity follows plain replication.
This peer has authority over the entity. The step runs and the samples go out from here.
This peer controls a predicted entity and runs it ahead of the server. See [NetwPredictionHandle].
A copy that runs forward and installs each sample it receives.
A frozen copy drawn from history, where it collides.
The step moves the entity once per tick.
The physics server moves the bodies in each frame that brings a tick, and the step runs once in that frame.

A [NetwPhysicsStepper] installed with [method NetwMultiplayer.predict_stepper_install] steps the space once per tick. An entity that does not declare prediction, or that stands in a space with no stepper, runs [constant SCHEDULE_FRAME] and reports one error.
[constant SCHEDULE_FRAME] when the entity has a physics body, and [constant SCHEDULE_TICK] otherwise.
Copies this peer has no authority over are [constant MODE_PROXY], unless a selection makes them active.
Copies this peer has no authority over are [constant MODE_ACTIVE].
A sample lands when it arrives, as it was sent.
A sample lands when it arrives, carried forward by its age along the property its interpolation projects by, for at most [member max_restore_ticks].
A sample is held until the clock's display tick reaches it, then lands as it was sent.
